name: Trigger.dev
author: triggerdotdev

control._comment: Stop order: dashboard first, then the supervisor that starts runners, then sidecars, redis, postgres last. Start is the reverse.

description: TypeScript background jobs and cron — the code-first counterpart to n8n. Trigger.dev v4 combined stack (webapp + supervisor), slimmed for this box: no ClickHouse, no s2-lite, 768 MiB Node heap. Dashboard on 127.0.0.1:8030 behind Serve; task images push to a loopback registry on :5000, not published on the tailnet. Magic-link login, links in docker logs trigger-webapp. ⚠️ Official wants 6+8 GB; this deploy caps idle around 2 GB and will OOM if ollama is loaded.
